title: riglab.weapon v1
description: A RigLab weapon rig (src/format/weapon.ts, validateWeapon): rigid bodies and the fixed grips the rig's hands hold them by. A body with one grip rides that hand at the grip's `angle`; a body with two grips is free, placed by each key, and its grips carry no angle. Rules this schema cannot express, which a reader must check itself: body names are unique within the weapon; grip names are unique within a body; a chain is gripped at most once in the whole weapon, and names a chain of the rig; a body's axis butt and tip are apart, and a free body's two grips sit at different points (both more than 1e-6 apart).

name.description: A name other than `unarmed`, the class that holds no weapon.
1-64 letters, digits, '_' or '-', starting with a letter.

axis.description: The butt and the tip in the body's own frame.

riding-grip.description: The one grip of a body that rides its hand: `angle` is the body's rotation relative to the gripping chain's lower bone, in degrees.

free-grip.description: One of a free body's two grips; two hands set its rotation.
